description: 203.0.113.50 sends UDP datagrams to ports 1-60 of 192.0.2.10; 58 closed ports answer ICMP port unreachable, 53 answers with DNS, 7 stays silent. Each port unreachable counts as a udp probe by the quoted source, so port_scan fires with scan type udp. 10 IPv6 probes from another address answered the same way stay below the threshold.
